one_liner: Cloud communications platform with Messaging, Voice, Video, Verify, Numbers, Reports, Network APIs.
access_notes: Self-serve signup provides an API key/secret and other creds from the dashboard. Live messaging/voice usage may require adding credit or number/brand registration depending on region, but credentials and basic sandbox/testing are self-serve.
mcp_notes: Official Vonage MCP servers: Documentation MCP Server and MCP Tooling Server (per Vonage press release: https://s29.q4cdn.com/651905246/files/doc_news/Vonage-Expands-Developer-Ecosystem-to-Accelerate-the-Next-Era-of-Enterprise-Digital-Transformation-2026.pdf)

evidence.quote: “When you create a Vonage account, an API key and secret will be created for you.”
“If you use message signatures, these are generated using the SIGNATURE_SECRET…”
“Messages supports both JWT and Basic… For most use-cases we recommend JWT Authentication.”
“you will need to sign up for an account. This will give you an API key and secret”
“We use OpenAPI to describe all our APIs, and we make those specifications publicly available too.”
“Webhook signing is enabled by default for the Messages, Dispatch, Verify, and Voice APIs.”
“Vonage has released two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers… [Documentation MCP Server]… [MCP Tooling Server].”

_trail.quote: Access is self_serve_free with no material blockers, so buildability moved to ready and blocker set to none; MCP notes clarified to name the official servers from the cited evidence.
